title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the silent stained-glass halls of Armstrong Browning to the high-tech pods in Moody, these are the most reliable environments for deep focus and collaboration on the Baylor campus.

cards.title: Sound-Dampening Moody PODS
cards.subtitle: Moody Memorial Library, Garden Level
cards.notes: Reserve these Framery pods for up to two hours. They offer power, HVAC, and lighting for focused solo work or small group collaboration in a sound-dampening environment.
cards.short_summary: Reservable sound-dampening pods for individual or small group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Moody PODS are reservable for up to two hours at a time and feature power, HVAC, and lighting for up to four people.
cards.source_title: Moody PODS | University Libraries, Museums, and the Press
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via LibCal; limited to 4 hours per week per user.

cards.title: Silent Study at Prichard Commons
cards.subtitle: Moody Memorial Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Enter this designated Silent Study Zone for absolute quiet. Group study and loud music are prohibited here to ensure a distraction-free environment for deep concentration.
cards.short_summary: A strictly enforced silent study zone on the second floor of Moody Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Prichard Information Commons is a designated Silent Study Zone where group study is not an option and even loud music through headphones is considered a distraction.
cards.source_title: Study Zones in Moody and Jones | University Libraries, Museums, and the Press
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; silence is strictly enforced.

cards.title: Serene Study in Armstrong Browning
cards.subtitle: 710 Speight Ave
cards.notes: Study amidst stained glass and Victorian poetry archives. This library is a mandatory quiet zone, offering a serene and picturesque atmosphere for reflective academic work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, historic library known for its stained glass and peaceful atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Armstrong Browning Library is a mandatory quiet zone known for its stained glass windows and serene environment, ideal for reflective study.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 5 famous study spots on Baylor's campus

cards.title: Cozy Couches in Barfield
cards.subtitle: Bill Daniel Student Center, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Snag a comfortable couch or lounge chair in this historic room. It provides a social yet productive atmosphere, though it often fills up quickly due to its popularity.
cards.short_summary: A popular lounge-style study space with comfortable seating in the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Barfield Drawing Room on the second floor of the Bill Daniel Student Center is a scenic study spot with cozy couches and lounge chairs.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 7 scenic (and safe) study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Available during Bill Daniel Student Center building hours.

cards.title: Modern Study at the BSB Atrium
cards.subtitle: Baylor Sciences Building
cards.notes: Utilize the open seating in this massive four-story atrium. It's a common area for science students, offering proximity to food and a bright, modern environment.
cards.short_summary: A bright, modern common area in the Baylor Sciences Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carlile Atrium in the Baylor Sciences Building is a common area for students and faculty, offering a modern study environment.
cards.source_title: Atrium and Outside Areas | Baylor Sciences Building
cards.access_notes: Swipe access for students enrolled in BSB classes extends until 10:00 p.m. on weekdays.

cards.title: Collaborative Foster Team Rooms
cards.subtitle: Paul L. Foster Campus for Business and Innovation
cards.notes: Reserve one of 35 team rooms designed for group projects. These spaces are equipped for collaboration and are primarily for business students and those in business classes.
cards.short_summary: High-tech group study rooms in the business school campus.
cards.evidence_claim: There are 35 Team Rooms within the Foster Campus which are reservable to HSB students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Team Rooms - Hankamer School of Business
cards.access_notes: Reservations required; priority given to Hankamer School of Business students.

cards.title: Focused Work at Jones Library
cards.subtitle: Jesse H. Jones Library
cards.notes: Find a quiet, less-crowded desk in the stacks of Jones Library. Connected to Moody by a hallway, it offers a calmer environment for long, undisturbed reading sessions.
cards.short_summary: A quieter, more intimate library space for focused individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Jones Library offers a calm, undisturbed space to read or research, with an intimate setting ideal for long study sessions.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 5 famous study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; designated as an Individual Study Zone.

cards.title: Renovated Study in Tidwell
cards.subtitle: Tidwell Bible Building
cards.notes: Study in the newly renovated Tidwell building, which features technology-enabled classrooms and a dedicated lounge for graduate students amidst historic architecture.
cards.short_summary: Modernized study and seminar spaces in the historic Tidwell Bible Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Tidwell Bible Building includes technology-enabled classrooms, graduate seminar rooms, and a dedicated graduate student lounge.
cards.source_title: Tidwell Bible Building - Give Light - Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Lounge access is dedicated to graduate students; classrooms available for general use.

cards.title: Legal Research Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Umphrey Law Center
cards.notes: Reserve a room for up to three hours in the Law Library. These rooms are equipped with dry-erase markers and are ideal for intensive group or individual legal research.
cards.short_summary: Reservable study rooms in the Sheridan & John Eddie Williams Legal Research Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Law students may reserve study rooms in three-hour blocks per day; dry-erase markers are available at the Circulation Desk.
cards.source_title: Library Services | Law School | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Reservations limited to law students; rooms can be booked for the current or following day.

cards.title: Outdoor Study at Truett
cards.subtitle: George W. Truett Theological Seminary
cards.notes: Enjoy a peaceful outdoor study session in this scenic courtyard. It offers a quiet alternative to indoor libraries, perfect for reading during mild weather.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, scenic outdoor courtyard for peaceful study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Truett Seminary courtyard is recognized as one of the most beautiful and scenic study spots on the Baylor campus.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » The 9 most beautiful study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during daylight hours.
